theorem lg_target {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {f : Set (α → β)} {s : Set α} (hf : f.Finite) (hs : s.Finite) : (f.seq s).Finite := by
  let g : s → β := by sorry -- placeholder for the function mapping elements of s to β
  let f_seq : Set (s → β) := f.seq s
  let f_seq_image : Set (s → β) := Set.image (fun g : s → β => ⟨g⟩) s
  have h_image : f_seq_image.Finite :=
    Set.Finite.image hf hs
  exact h_image
